search_text: published ZDI-14-329 ZDI-CAN-2331 Sophos Cyberoam add_guest_user Blind SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2014-10-01 CVE-2014-5503 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2014-5503 8.5 ['Sophos'] ['Cyberoam'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL on vulnerable installations of Sophos Cyberoam. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the add_guest_user opcode. The issue lies in the failure to properly sanitize the specified mobile number prior to executing a SQL query.
